text:
rachel: Customer reported rerank returning zeros for ~70% of the list. They included a small payload and the response. request id: req_20240805_aa33

josh: Can you paste the exact body they sent and the truncated response?

rachel: Payload they used (copied):
```
{
  "query_text": "how do i cancel an order and get a refund",
  "documents": [
    {"doc_id": "p1", "content": "Cancel within 14 days for full refund."},
    {"doc_id": "p2", "content": "Refunds show up in 5-7 business days."}
  ]
}
```

rachel: Service response (truncated):
```
{
  "request_id": "req_20240805_aa33",
  "scores": [0, 0],
  "note": "some candidates skipped"
}
```

priya: Looks like they mixed shapes. Rerank expects either top-level "query" + "candidates" (array of text items) OR the passage-style payload the search endpoint uses. "query_text" + "documents" won't map.

marco: Right — our reranker does a simple validation: if it doesn't find a recognized query key or a candidates array, it short-circuits to a neutral scorer that emits zeros and a lightweight warning (status 200). That's why they got zeros instead of a 4xx.

josh: Customer said they got 200. Should we change to 422 for ambiguous payloads? Breaking change risk.

priya: We should discuss API change, but for now give a workaround. Quick client-side fix: rename query_text -> query and move document text into candidates with a text field. Example payload to send them:
```
{
  "query": "how do i cancel an order and get a refund",
  "candidates": [
    {"id": "p1", "text": "Cancel within 14 days for full refund."},
    {"id": "p2", "text": "Refunds show up in 5-7 business days."}
  ]
}
```

rachel: Sent that suggestion plus a curl snippet: 
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{"query":"refund","candidates":[{"id":"p1","text":"..."}]}'
```

marco: Also proposing a quick SDK patch to accept common aliases (query_text -> query, documents -> candidates) and normalize on the client before sending. Low-risk and helps new users.

infra-bot: Ticket INF-1201 created by josh. Priority: P2. Assigned: eng-ml/rerank-team.

rachel: Customer will try the change and confirm. I'll update the ticket when they respond. Thanks :thumbsup:
